notes.title: Patch 1.11: Overworld and Dungeons Update
notes.content:
Started implementation on an Overworld for the game that includes:
[list]
[*] A quest system that allows players to play dungeons and earn rewards upon successfully completing them
[*] An inventory that shows all your loot
[*] An explorable area with access to a training area
[/list]

2 Dungeon bosses have been added for the Fire Elemental Dungeon:
[list]
[*] A Flamespitter Demon that hunts down its target with its underlings
[*] A set of embers that just want to watch the world burn
[/list]

3 Quests are available to the player by going into the Guild Hall and talking to the individuals behind the counter:
[list]
[*] A quest to take down the Flamespitter Demon
[*] A quest to take down the Coal Golem
[*] A quest to take down the Tears of Fire
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.10
notes.content:
[h1]Combat System Update[/h1]
[h2]Style Meter[/h2]

The combat system entails a style meter with levels that increase/decrease when the bar fills/empties. Players can quickly fill up the style meter by casting spells unique from the last 4 unique spells they used; players can slightly fill up the style meter by casting spells that were not just previously cast (aka spamming the same spell does not increase the style meter but alternating between 2 spells would); players will slightly empty the style meter by casting the same spell repeatedly. The style meter rewards players that fill it up from F-S by increasing the player's Spell Power the higher the rating is (F being the bottom, S being the top for a total of 7 style levels).

[h2]Charge Levels[/h2]

Each Chargefire and Dashfire spell now have charges that increase the strength of the spell as well as include empowered effects based on the number of charges at cast time. All available charges are consumed once the spell is cast, and charges all refill at the same rate. Some spells have more spell charges than others. Channelfire (Ultimate) spells have charges too but take style to gain charges; Ultimate spells are weak at low charge levels but insanely strong at the higher charge levels.


[h1]New Spell Classes[/h1]
[h2]Stone Stance[/h2]

This is the first implemented defensive class that also has a unique mechanic of reactivating defensive spells to form an offensive spell. For full detailed information on the class, check the classes area in-game.


[h2]Winter Stance[/h2]

This is a reinvented utility class that helps the player weaken and control the enemies. For full detailed information on the class, check the classes area in-game.

notes.title: Patch 1.03: Dungeons Update
notes.content:
Howdy, all! Welcome to the new patch where we will be starting testing on the full Dungeon experience. In this update, we have a new level that has the initial design for all future dungeons, a Titan for the final enemy, and updated mobs for the pathways and mob rooms. Also included in this patch, we have some minor spell adjustments to help with consistently hitting your spells and some more information about the game and how to play it in the main menu. Please continue reading for more detailed information about these topics.

[h1]The Sentinel of Flames: The Titan of Fire[/h1]

This is the first Titan of the game and as such we are looking to see how it interacts with players and what players think of it as a final boss monster for the dungeon. Titans are very similar to Bosses in that they behave much in the same way. The big difference comes when you increase the difficulty, granting the Titan extra lives, new attacks, and new passive mechanics that make the Titan a scary beast in more difficult dungeon experiences. Seeing as we only have an easy mode for the dungeon so far, the player will not be seeing this just yet, but stay tuned for the next update where we hope to include at least one more difficulty setting.

[h2]Phase 1 Primary Attacks[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Attack 1: Releases a full ring of fire outwards, damaging all allies that are hit by it.
[*] Attack 2: Releases a large burst of projectiles in all directions around the Titan, damaging all allies that are hit by it.
[*] Attack 3: Targets up to 3 allies with a tracking laser that damages after a brief delay; laser can be blocked by both defensive spells and Towers surrounding the Phoenix.
[*] Attack 4: Creates 6 heat-seeking projectiles that track the player and one other ally, if applicable, until destroyed or hit their target.
[/olist]

[h2]Phase 1 Special Attacks[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Attack 1: Fires out 5 equidistant beams of fire around the Titan that rotate around the Titan damaging every Ally in its path for 5 seconds; lasers can be blocked by both defensive spells and Towers surrounding the Phoenix.
[*] Attack 2: Summons a giant pool of fire at a target location after a brief delay, damaging all allies hit.
[/olist]

[h2]Phase 1 Ultimate Attack[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Attack: Channels, healing itself for a portion of its maximum health every tick for 10 seconds; upon completing the channel, the air around you explodes, damaging all allies in the arena. Can be canceled by Stunning the Boss while channeling.
[/olist]

[h2]Phase 1 Passive Mechanic[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Passive: Upon spawning, summons 4 Towers around it that grant damage reduction to the Titan if healthy enough; Towers can be damaged similarly to a Mob but cannot be killed. Upon falling below 75% health, the Tower will stop granting the buff to the Titan, and upon healing back to 75% health, the Tower will grant the buff to the Titan.
[/olist]

[h1]Dungeon Setup[/h1]
Dungeons are set up to a simple point A to point B line with no branching segments off of the main path. Dungeon areas consist of 2 main types of areas: Rooms and Pathways. Rooms consist of larger, square areas that Mobs or Bosses will spawn in, based on the type of room it is. Pathways are the areas between these rooms that have Mobs inside of them upon entering the Pathway. There are 4 types of Rooms in dungeons:
[list]
[*] Starting Room: The room the player spawns in for the dungeon. Is free of any enemies.
[*] Mob Room: The smallest room of the enemy rooms. Contains a swarm of Mob enemies upon entering the room. Dungeons contain a lot of these rooms, spliced between Boss and Titan Rooms.
[*] Boss Room: the middle room of the enemy rooms. Contains a singular Boss that spawns upon entering the room. Can be 1-4 Boss rooms based on the difficulty of the dungeon.
[*] Titan Room: The final room in the dungeon. Contains the Titan that spawns upon entering the room. Upon completing this room, the dungeon will end and the player will have the option of replaying the dungeon or returning to the menu.
[/list]

[h1]Spell Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] All projectile spells have increased velocity to help with accurately hitting your target.
[*] Some spells have had hitboxes and/or stats modified
[/list]

[h1]HUD Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reticle is now toggleable with the Tab Button on the Keyboard/Mouse; no implementation for controller yet...sorry.
[*] Option to now play with First Person camera or Third Person camera in the main menu.
[*] Enemies with cancelable channels now have bars to accurately show the player when they are channeling and how close to finishing it they are.
[/list]

[h1]Main Menu Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] How to Play submenu now added to better inform the player about the game
[*] Rearranged the buttons to a more orderly fashion
[*] Settings submenu added to allow for the First-Person/Third-Person camera option
[/list]


That's all for this update. If you want to give me feedback on my game or become a more in-depth playtester/designer/artist, I am always looking for more help. You can join our public discord here: https://discord.gg/FCT72UVN

notes.title: Patch 1.02: Boss Update
notes.content:
Howdy! I've been hard at work with making a boss for the game. The boss is now in a playable state for the game in its own game mode. In later patches, I will move the boss into the dungeon where it belongs; for now, we will be letting it have its own game mode for testing purposes. I also made some small HUD adjustments for the player. Below is a list of all the changes made in the game.

Coal Golem (New Dungeon Boss)
Primary Attack 1: Drops a large, flaming boulder on top of the Boss's current target, damaging all allies within the damage radius
Primary Attack 2: Pounds the ground around him after a brief delay, damaging all allies within the damage radius
Primary Attack 3: Summons a line of fire on the ground that damages all allies after a brief delay
Primary Attack 4: Creates an expanding curved projectile that travels forward, damaging all allies hit
Primary Attack 5: Creates a circle and ring of fire around the current target, damaging them after a brief delay
Special Attack 1: Creates a wall of fire that travels forward, damaging all allies in its path
Special Attack 2: Breathes a cone of fire forward for 5 seconds; if the target is not in the center, the boss will slowly rotate towards the target
Ultimate Attack: Charges up a large aoe fire explosion that damages all players after a 5-second delay
Passive Mechanic: The boss will damage all units (allied and enemy) every second until killed

Boss Gameplay
The boss will attack the player at regular intervals attempting to use its ultimate move, then its special move, and finally its primary move, stopping after the first move has been used. Ultimate moves have a 2-minute cooldown, special moves have a 30-second cooldown, and primary attacks have a 3-5 second cooldown. After an attack, the boss will have a small cooldown window to avoid instantly spamming attacks without any recourse.

HUD changes
Bosses will have a bar at the top of the HUD showing their health at all times
The player can now press Tab to toggle the visibility of the outer ring of the reticle
All mobs now have a health bar above them instead of on the HUD

That's all for this week; tune in next week for some more exciting changes geared towards gameplay and camera options. If you want to give me feedback on my game or become a more in-depth playtester/designer/artist, I am always looking for more help. You can join our public discord here: https://discord.gg/FCT72UVN

notes.title: Patch 1.01: Mob Update
notes.content:
Howdy! I've been busy this week restructuring and organizing the player and pawn systems this week as well as updating the current mobs in the game. Since I did not properly set up the structure, I needed to go back and reconfigure it for future updates and additions to make content for the game more easily. As for the mobs, I have made adjustments to the enemies to make them not feel like automated robots that have homing missiles and undodgeable attacks. I now have all mob enemies have randomized attack timers for all their attacks to give a variation of the attacks from similar mobs (basically I made the mobs not perform a coordinated attack against the player at once). Another addition was the Special Attack. All mobs now have special attacks that have longer cooldowns than their normal attacks but pack a more powerful punch and/or have unique effects. Below are the changes/additions/removals of all the mobs in the game:

Fire Sprite (the floating red guy that shoots lasers): 
New Primary: Now shoots a fireball at the player
New Special: Now charges up a beam that stays in place and then damages all allies hit in its path
New Movement: Now doesn't circle the player; the Fire Sprite will attempt to move towards the player if they are too far away. The Fire Sprite will otherwise look for a random location near its current position and hover towards that location.

Hell Hound (the running mob that leaves fire trails):
Primary is the old attack: A trail of fire wherever the Hell Hound walks, damaging players who step on it.
New Special: Now launches a projectile towards the player that leaves a fire trail behind it similar to the Primary Attack
New Movement: The Hell Hound no longer wanders aimlessly; the Hell Hound will attempt to find a location in a cone behind the player and move towards it

Flame Acolyte (the mob in the corner that blinks away if the player got too close): Removed

Flame Nades (the small guys that leaped into the air and blew up upon reaching the player): Removed

*New*
Kindleflame:
Primary: Shoots out eight fireballs around itself that go directly forward
Special: Blinks near the player and charges up an explosive AoE attack that detonates after 2 seconds
Movement: None (stays motionless on the floor of the arena)

Sunbomber:
Primary: Shoots out fast-paced projectiles directly toward its target
Special: Shoots out a burst of its Primary in a cone towards its target
Movement: None (hangs out on the walls)


That's all for this week. Hopefully next week I can continue my progress and work towards a boss enemy and possibly some new spell classes. If you want to give me feedback on my game or become a more in-depth playtester/designer/artist, I am always looking for more help. You can join our public discord here: https://discord.gg/FCT72UVN
